evidence.label: Home page
evidence.detail: Title "Mua sắm LocknLock – Ưu đãi sốc đến 50%, giao hàng toàn quốc"; description 144 characters; 18363 words; 0 H1

evidence.label: Structured data
evidence.detail: JSON-LD types found: BreadcrumbList, ContactPoint, ListItem, Organization, PostalAddress, SearchAction, WebSite

evidence.label: Prices and contact
evidence.detail: Prices visible (235.000 đ, 280.000 đ, 318.000 đ, 403.000 đ); contact details present

evidence.label: Crawl files
evidence.detail: robots.txt read; sitemap not parsed; llms.txt missing

evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: robots.txt has no Content-Signal declaration. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (3 pages checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (3 pages checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: /llms.txt returned HTTP 404 with an HTML page. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: WARN: Organization JSON-LD is missing description. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Page Metadata
evidence.detail: WARN: canonical missing on 1 page, og:type missing on 3 pages, and duplicate titles. Fix: Give every page a unique title, a meta description, a canonical link, `<html lang>`, and og:image and og:type.

evidence.label: Content Freshness
evidence.detail: WARN: None of the sampled pages says when it was published or updated. Fix: State when each page was published and last updated: `datePublished` and `dateModified` in JSON-LD (or `article:modified_time`), and keep them accurate. Answer engi

evidence.label: About, Contact, and Privacy Pages
evidence.detail: FAIL: about isn't linked, contact isn't linked, and privacy isn't linked. Fix: Link About, Contact, and Privacy pages from the homepage. Agents use them to judge who is behind a site.

evidence.label: Document Structure
evidence.detail: WARN: 3 of 3 pages have structure issues (no H1 and skipped heading levels). Fix: Wrap the main content in `<main>`, use one H1 per page, and don't skip heading levels.

evidence.label: Accessible Controls
evidence.detail: WARN: 1494 of 1532 controls have an accessible name (98%); 16 unlabeled form fields; 3 clickable non-native elements. Fix: Give every link, button, and form field an accessible name, label form fields, and use native `<a>` and `<button>` ra

headline: LocknLock scores 72/100, but missing llms.txt, markdown, and trust links limit AI readiness.

findings.title: Homepage does not link to About, Contact, or Privacy pages
findings.why: AI agents cannot easily verify who is behind the site when key trust pages are unlinked from the homepage.
findings.fix: Link the About, Contact, and Privacy pages directly from the homepage.

findings.title: Missing llms.txt, discovery Link headers, and Content-Signal rules
findings.why: AI crawlers hit a 404 on /llms.txt and receive no Link headers or Content-Signal rules to guide content use.
findings.fix: Publish /llms.txt, add homepage Link discovery headers, and add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt.

findings.title: No Markdown versions available for AI agents
findings.why: None of the sampled pages return Markdown via Accept headers or .md URLs, making clean text extraction harder.
findings.fix: Serve Markdown versions of pages for Accept: text/markdown requests and at .md URLs.

findings.title: Missing H1s, broken heading order, duplicate titles, and incomplete Organization
findings.why: Pages lack H1 tags, skip heading levels, repeat titles, miss og:type and a canonical tag, and omit an Organization description.
findings.fix: Use one H1 and ordered headings per page, unique titles, full metadata, and an Organization JSON-LD description.

findings.title: No publication or update dates on sampled pages
findings.why: AI assistants cannot tell how current the content is because no sampled page states when it was published or updated.
findings.fix: Add accurate datePublished and dateModified fields to JSON-LD on each page.
